name: Itsu no Ma ni ka Mucchimuchi Datta Imouto to Guchogucho
original_name: いつの間にかムッチムチだった妹とグチョグチョ
source:
She's lost the baby fat but still oh so soft...
oniichan slips his throbber into loli's special place
so it goes "gucho-gucho" ~ 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE185992.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
虽然婴儿肥已经减掉了，但还是那么柔软……
Oniichan将他的throbber滑入萝莉的特殊位置
所以就变成了“gucho-gucho”~ 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE185992.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
